project_type: Monorepo (pnpm workspace) - LINE Webhook Lambda handlers (TypeScript / Node.js 20), Bedrock AgentCore (Python 3.12), AWS CDK infra (TypeScript)
build_system: pnpm workspaces, tsc for TypeScript compilation
test_framework: vitest (configured in functions package.json but no test files exist yet)
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install 2. pnpm typecheck 3. pnpm build 4. pnpm test (if test files exist)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No Docker daemon needed for this task.
contribution_requirements: CI runs pnpm typecheck on PRs. Must pass TypeScript type checking.
key_patterns: - Shared utilities live in packages/functions/src/shared/ - Handler in packages/functions/src/webhook/handler.ts - AWS SDK clients instantiated at module top-level with caching pattern - Environment variables passed from CDK via Lambda environment - S3 bucket name via BUCKET_NAME env var - CDK constructs in packages/infra/lib/constructs/ grant permissions to Lambda
directory_structure: packages/functions/src/webhook/ - Lambda handlers, packages/functions/src/shared/ - shared utilities, packages/infra/lib/constructs/ - CDK constructs, packages/infra/lib/stacks/ - CDK stacks
